record.question: Pick out the correct answers to whom Central Services (Medical Attendance) Rules, 1944 shall apply:
options: Government servants who are on leave preparatory to retirement
Officers of the All India Services
record.explanation: Defective item: the printed paper (p.3) shows this as a multi-select worth 5 marks with eight options (a)-(h); the bank captured only (a)-(d), dropping (e) State Government servants on deputation with the Central Government, (f) Civilians paid from Defence Services Estimates, (g) Government servants on leave or deputation abroad, (h) Apprentices. Under the Central Services (Medical Attendance) Rules, 1944 the rules apply to serving Central Government servants including probationers, those on leave preparatory to retirement, All India Services officers and civilians paid from Defence Services Estimates, but not to retired officials or whole-time apprentices. Thus 'A probationer', 'leave preparatory to retirement' and 'Officers of the All India Services' are all correct among the supplied options, so no unique single answer exists; the item is held pending restoration of the printed options (e)-(h) and a multi-answer format.
